paragraphs: International gold is at $4,124 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.05 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,727/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (7 headlines), Inflation (4 headlines), Investment flows (ETFs) (2 headlines), Records and profit-taking (2 headlines).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Price Forecast: High Treasury Yields Put $4,000 Support in Focus (FXEmpire); Gold Slips as Treasury Yields Hold Firm, Fed Path Keeps Bullion Boxed In (BigGo Finance).

Inflation. Gold is held as an inflation hedge, though hot inflation can also mean higher rates, which cuts the other way. In the news: Gold prices declined amid cautious anticipation of the Federal Reserve meeting and US inflation data (صوت الإمارات); Precious Metals StoneX Bullion weekly round-up 101926; US Inflation higher-for-longer? (StoneX).

Investment flows (ETFs). Money moving into or out of gold funds shows what investors are doing with their own cash. In the news: Forget GLD. Investors Sent $500 Million to the Cheaper SPDR Gold Fund (24/7 Wall St.); Gold Prices Slid, but Gold Fund Holdings Just Hit a Record. Here’s Who Keeps Buying (Money Talks News).
